segments.name: Journey
segments.description: Commercializes branded dermatology products approved by the FDA for sale in the United States.
segments.evidence: Through our partner company Journey we market the following branded dermatology products approved by the FDA for sale in the United States:

segments.name: Avenue
segments.description: Develops biopharmaceutical assets, including a licensed product candidate for lysosomal storage diseases.
segments.evidence: Avenue entered into a license agreement with Duke University ("Duke"), pursuant to which Avenue obtained from Duke an exclusive, worldwide license to certain patents and know-how for the development and commercialization of products, including ATX-04 (clenbuterol), for the treatment of lysosomal storage diseases

segments.name: Checkpoint
segments.evidence: Checkpoint results through May 2025 due to deconsolidation as a result of acquisition by Sun Pharma (see Note 3).

segments.name: Mustang
segments.description: A biopharmaceutical subsidiary focused on acquiring, developing and commercializing assets in different therapeutic and disease areas.
segments.evidence: Each public subsidiary is a biopharmaceutical company focused on acquiring, developing, and commercializing assets in different therapeutic and disease areas.

segments.name: Fortress
products: ZYCUBO (copper histidinate, also referred to as CUTX-101)
segments.description: Comprises the parent entity and private subsidiaries, including Cellvation, Cyprium, Helocyte, Oncogenuity and Urica, primarily funded by Fortress.
segments.evidence: Includes Fortress and private subsidiaries primarily funded by Fortress, including Cellvation, Cyprium, Helocyte, Oncogenuity and Urica; and intercompany eliminations.

revenueModel.text: Fortress earns product revenue from Journey's dermatology product sales, plus milestone, royalty and dividend streams from subsidiaries and partners.
revenueModel.evidence: Fortress Biotech, Inc. ("Fortress" or the "Company") is a biopharmaceutical company focused on acquiring and advancing assets to enhance long-term value for shareholders through product revenue, equity holding and dividend and royalty revenue streams.

changes.evidence: Checkpoint results through May 2025 due to deconsolidation as a result of acquisition by Sun Pharma (see Note 3).
